name: Physlib Foundations Report: The framework for general probabilistic theories
description: Physlib Contribution Report on work by Tom Diem: “The framework for general probabilistic theories”.

issuer.name: Physlib Contributions
issuer.description: An open-source community project to digitalize results from physics into Lean 4. Physlib Contributions publishes signed reports on reviewing, maintenance, refactoring, foundations, formalisation and documentation of Physlib.

credentialSubject.narrative: This work laid the foundation for future formalizations in Physlib by establishing a common mathematical framework for classical, quantum and more general probabilistic theories. It introduces fundamental notions of states, observables and measurements, allowing results to be developed at a level of generality that makes them applicable across widely different fields of physics.

achievement.name: Physlib Foundations Report
achievement.description: For setting up the basic definitions and first properties of an area of physics in Physlib, such as spacetime, tensors, quantum states or thermodynamic systems, so that other results can be stated and proved.

criteria.narrative:
- The work introduced or substantially developed basic definitions and their elementary properties in Physlib.
- The work was merged and is used, or is designed to be used, by other parts of the library.
- Links to the relevant pull requests and modules are given as evidence.
